name: tashkalinskaya-control
description: Система внутреннего контроля Ташкалинской кондитерской фабрики

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w @tashkalinskaya/api && npm run build -w @tashkalinskaya/worker && npm run build -w @tashkalinskaya/web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @tashkalinskaya/contracts && npm run build -w @tashkalinskaya/database
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names web,api,worker --prefix-colors cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.test: npm run test:scripts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:load:validate: node scripts/load-test.mjs --validate tests/load/local-70-read.json && node scripts/load-test.mjs --validate tests/load/factory-staging.example.json
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
